description: This source file implements display and formatting functions for a calculator engine, including number conversion, validation, grouping, and display logic within the CalcEngine namespace.

classes.name: LASTDISP
classes.description: Struct holding the last display state of the calculator, including current value, precision, radix, and formatting options.

methods.name: DisplayNum
methods.description: Converts the current value to a string in the current radix, applies formatting, and updates the display if necessary.

methods.name: IsNumberInvalid
methods.description: Validates the number string for overflow or unknown characters based on radix and formatting rules.

methods.name: DigitGroupingStringToGroupingVector
methods.description: Parses a regional digit grouping string into a vector of grouping sizes.

methods.name: GroupDigitsPerRadix
methods.description: Applies digit grouping formatting to a number string based on radix.

methods.name: GroupDigits
methods.description: Inserts grouping separators into a number string according to specified grouping pattern.
